name: dsh-compaction-retry
description: Retries DSH session-compaction summarization requests with a provider-style retry policy (mode / maxRetries / retryableCodes / backoff), mirroring @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry, via the compaction/summary-error waterfall. Prevents transient upstream 429/5xx from failing automatic compaction or a model switch with MODEL_SWITCH_COMPACTION_FAILED. The client half shows a Codex-style "正在压缩上下文…" row above the composer (with retry and pre-model-switch detail) fed by the host's /compaction-retry/status route.
